# `number_assignment`

Area: **inventory** ([all tables](README.md))

Order-owned number claims; half-open business dates, retained cancelled audit versions.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Assignment audit version UUID. |
| `audit_sequence` | `bigint` | no |  | Unique insertion sequence, not transaction commit ordering. |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Acceptance instant from the injected clock. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | Last transition instant from the injected clock. |
| `subscriber_number_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Claimed subscriber number; history prevents its deletion. |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Product realized by this number during valid_for. |
| `assigned_by_item_id` | `uuid` | no |  | Order item accepting the claim. |
| `ended_by_item_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Order item releasing the number, when released_on is set. |
| `effective_from` | `date` | no |  | Inclusive first business date; future claims reserve capacity. |
| `released_on` | `date` | yes |  | Exclusive release business date; quarantine begins here. |
| `valid_for` | `daterange` | yes | `daterange(effective_from, released_on, '[)'::text)` | Generated [effective_from, released_on); same-day claims are empty. |
| `quarantine_days` | `integer` | no |  | Quarantine setting at acceptance; later changes cannot revoke a claim. |
| `cancelled_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Cancellation instant; cancelled versions retain audit but claim no range. |
| `cancelled_by_item_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | Order item whose cancellation voided this audit version. |
